en.description:
Memedoku — a cozy logic puzzle, built for Apple Watch.

Place exactly one cat in every row, every column, and every colored region — and no two cats may sit next to each other. A sudoku-style brain teaser of pure deduction, now right on your wrist. No phone needed.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Simple to learn: tap to place a cat, tap to mark a paw
• One cat per row, per column, per color, none touching — pure logic, no guessing
• Satisfying place / conflict / solve animations & haptics
• Smooth difficulty curve: grid size and region shapes grow as you improve; rules are taught step by step
• 3 hearts and a gentle timer keep every board a fair, focused challenge
• Endless procedurally-generated levels — always one unique solution
• A fresh Daily Puzzle every day, shared by everyone
• Play fully offline, anytime — a brain break on your wrist
• Progress saved automatically
• Built native for Apple Watch — no iPhone required

If you love Sudoku and logic grids, Memedoku is your new daily ritual.
en.subtitle: Logic brain teaser, daily
